scope_note: Real images for the detector smoke check (AC1) and the PyTorch/ONNX parity sample (AC3). Not a benchmark: no ground truth, no split, a handful of hand-picked photographs. Images are never committed; python -m aeris.detection.samples fetch downloads them to data/raw/detector_samples/ and writes the verified provenance there.
selection_note: Commons candidates were shortlisted on 2026-09-25 from web search results only, because this environment's network policy denies commons.wikimedia.org and upload.wikimedia.org. Their licence claims come from search summaries and are unverified. The fetch tool accepts a file only if the Commons API reports an allowed licence, and verifies the SHA-1 that Commons records. The fixed parity sample is chosen after fetching and viewing, and recorded by SHA-256.
allowed_licenses_note: Commons licence codes, matched as shell-style patterns: public domain, CC0, CC BY and CC BY-SA of any version. NC and ND variants are refused.

entries.license_note: Shipped in the Apache-2.0 YOLOX repository at the pinned commit; the repository does not name the photographer or give separate terms. Used locally only, not redistributed.
